Class FrankfurterFeedConnector

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.connector.instrument.BaseFeedConnector
grafioschtrader.connector.instrument.frankfurter.FrankfurterApiFeedConnector
grafioschtrader.connector.instrument.frankfurter.FrankfurterFeedConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedConnector
@Component public class FrankfurterFeedConnector extends FrankfurterApiFeedConnector
The public Frankfurter instance at api.frankfurter.dev. It requires no API key and imposes no monthly quota, only an unspecified protection against abuse.

The root URL is injected rather than hard coded, so an installation can point this connector at a mirror or at a self-hosted instance without a code change. It defaults to the public host, hence the connector is always activated.
